entries.title: A Refuge at the Gate
entries.text: You came to Babel fleeing famine and plague. A voice still calls above the bells. Seek the star on the high ledge to the left; a blade awaits there.
entries.controls: ARROWS  Move     SPACE / C  Jump     G  Recall your path

entries.title: The First Oath
entries.text: The first guardian holds the secret of Shockwave. Follow the road east into the tower; your blade is only the beginning.
entries.controls: X  Strike     G  Recall your path

entries.title: The Unwelcoming City
entries.text: No palms welcome the Hollow to this city of stone. Carry your hope through the forest passage and enter the keep.

entries.title: The Builders' Burden
entries.text: This bridge carried stone toward a heaven its builders never reached. Its tired joints groan beneath your feet.

entries.title: Beneath the Prophecy
entries.text: The bridge is gone, but your vow remains. Turn left through the lower halls: a heavy tread guards the power to break stone.
entries.controls: Seek the first guardian to the left

entries.title: Stone That Remembers
entries.text: These fractured stones will not yield to an ordinary blade. Seek the first guardian in the lower halls to the left.

entries.title: The Weight of Judgment
entries.text: A heavy blade scrapes the chamber floor. Its keeper holds the secret of Shockwave; face him before seeking the eastern passages.

entries.title: The Prophecy Unsealed
entries.text: Move freely during the blast; its direction stays locked. It breaks successive layers of fractured stone. Return east: the buried warden guards Wall Jump.
entries.controls: ARROWS  Aim | Z  Cast | 1 Spirit | 2.5 seconds

entries.title: A Fracture in the Oath
entries.text: The old masonry bears a wound. A sustained Shockwave breaks successive layers of cracked stone. Ordinary masonry stops the blast.
entries.controls: ARROWS  Aim     Z  Shatter a layer

entries.title: A Voice Under Stone
entries.text: Something moves beneath the roots. The buried rebel holds the secret of Wall Jump. Follow the lower passage into his broad chamber.
entries.controls: Watch the shadow beneath your feet

entries.title: The Profaned Court
entries.text: Wall Jump is yours. Leave the court where forgiveness was sold. Climb the vine-bound passages above and right; the winged preacher guards Double Jump.
entries.controls: Press toward a wall, then SPACE / C to leap away

entries.title: The Memory Above
entries.text: A star waits above the broken stone. Aim Shockwave upward to open the alcove, then use the walls to reach it.
entries.controls: UP + Z  Break the seal above

entries.title: Borrowed Wings
entries.text: The judge above calls the ground a prison. His secret is Double Jump; make his arrogance your road upward.
entries.controls: The next guardian waits in the chamber ahead

entries.title: A Sermon Answered
entries.text: Double Jump is yours. Mercy belongs to those below as well as those above. Ascend the eastern keep; the host of the empty table guards Crystal Dash.
entries.controls: SPACE / C again while airborne  Double Jump

entries.title: A Gilded Promise
entries.text: Gold cannot buy a way out of Babel. The sentinel ahead holds the secret of Crystal Dash, the last art you need for the ascent.

entries.title: The Last Place at the Table
entries.text: Crystal Dash is yours. Livia refused a feast bought with her people's hunger. Climb toward the high central crown and the master who keeps her captive.
entries.controls: ARROWS  Aim     Hold SHIFT for 0.7 seconds to Dash

entries.title: The Refused Sacrifice
entries.text: Nero demands that one life redeem his broken heaven. Find him in the high central hall. Beyond his throne lies the passage to Livia.
entries.controls: Face the master in the high central hall

entries.title: A Promise Freely Kept
entries.text: The tyrant has fallen; his promise no longer binds the princess. Take the open western passage left. Livia waits beneath a sky that belongs to everyone.
entries.controls: Leave the final chamber through its left exit

entries.title: The Fallen Guardian's Seal
entries.text: The guardian's fall has awakened this fractured seal. Use your new Shockwave to break it, then return east through the lower halls.
